# Hyo-Jung Kang | Official Website

Official multilingual website of ballet artist and Principal Dancer Hyo-Jung Kang (Korean: Kang Hyo-jung, Korean name: 강효정).

## Main pages
- English: https://kang.dance/
- German: https://kang.dance/de/
- Korean: https://kang.dance/ko/
- Biography: https://kang.dance/bio.html
- News and performances: https://kang.dance/news.html
- Media and videos: https://kang.dance/media.html
- Press archive: https://kang.dance/press.html
- Professional contact: https://kang.dance/contact.html

## Core facts
- Principal Dancer, Semperoper Ballett Dresden, since 2025.
- Principal Dancer, Vienna State Ballet, 2021-2025.
- Principal Dancer, Stuttgart Ballet, 2011-2021.
- Prix de Lausanne Scholarship Prize winner, 2002.
- Training: Sunhwa Arts School, Kirov Academy of Ballet, John Cranko School.
